source_assessment.scope: PDP participant proxy lifetime across discovery processing and removal/update; not a graph-equality predicate.
source_assessment.legacy_taxonomy_limit: The captured S1.B3 row is historical attribution, not proof of builtin/graph inconsistency or a normative oracle.
source_assessment.reported_affected_version: latest master; exact reported SHA unknown
not_sufficient: Configured concurrency or concurrent user-data publishing does not demonstrate a PDP update/removal interleaving.
The original reporter lock-placement suggestion is not an accepted fix; the report also describes intra-process deadlock concerns.
A later normal result, graph snapshot, or fixed-version pass cannot establish a historical failure.

observation_layers.scope: Participant/endpoint lifecycle intent and logical generation.
observation_layers.limitation: An input or plan is not applied DDS behavior.

observation_layers.scope: Opt-in Fast DDS reliable stateful matched GUID set under the sampled entity mutex.
observation_layers.limitation: Not a PDP proxy create/update/clear trace, distributed atomic snapshot, or matching epoch.

observation_layers.scope: Fresh identity-bound graph snapshots and attributable delivery observations when independently qualified.
observation_layers.limitation: Cannot substitute for an independent internal discovery source or infer an unobserved interleaving.

observation_layers.scope: Proxy creation/update/removal and use by assignRemoteEndpoints, with ordering and lifetime identity.
observation_layers.limitation: Current peer snapshot provider does not observe these events; a separately qualified observer is required.

requirements.statement: Correlate the lifetime of one remote participant proxy across discovery processing, update/removal and endpoint assignment.
evidence_required: Actual internal event order around proxy create/update/clear and assignRemoteEndpoints.
Proxy identity/incarnation, participant GUID, thread identity, lock/copy lifetime evidence and before/after raw anchors.
Independent external result and process health; missing internal events remain unknown.

requirements.statement: Bind actual participant and endpoint create/destroy/recreate to ownership, generation and directed peer relations.
evidence_required: Actual participant GUID and endpoint GID per logical entity/incarnation.
Participant group and same-process/cross-process ownership, PID/start identity and create/delete acknowledgement.
Old association removal and new-generation binding; aggregate counts alone retain an identity gap.

requirements.statement: Keep model intent, internal discovery facts and external graph/delivery observations independently attributable.
evidence_required: Separate raw sources with supported schema, observation mode, entity/generation and execution binding.
Fresh before/after snapshots, requires/ACK chronology, raw path/hash, rule/verdict and any unavailable field.
Missing internal fields are unknown; never copy graph/configuration values into internal observations.

requirements.statement: Qualify a stable normal workload and independently measure observer/tool effects before interpreting anomalies.
evidence_required: Stable normal control with workload/input identity, vendor/version, RMW, repeat and observation completeness.
Black-box control without instrumentation overrides and a separate instrumented build/binary/process manifest.
Observer/tool control with comparable workload and version; retain failures and overhead/loss limitations.

requirements.statement: Record exact pre/post and reported-version limitations separately; assess each real result without transferring qualification.
evidence_required: Exact source parent/fix commit and independent build/binary/environment provenance for each side.
Comparable normal workload, raw result and failure attribution per version; absent material is unverified.
Use the common anomaly/replay/review records with original raw hashes and replay attempt or a named non_replayable reason.
Historical reproduction and user-confirmed independent new-root counting remain distinct.

historical_comparison.backport_limit: Release references do not establish identical backport commit identity or all affected releases.
